description: Per-form theme / Appearance tab (design §0 prerequisite + §1). Adds Vitest to apps/api (first, so later security tests are runnable), a `theme` object inside schema.settings threaded through the API type/defaults/Zod/merge/public-payload, a web theme.ts resolver + font loader, a reusable Cloudinary upload helper, a new editor Appearance tab with live preview, and theme application on PublicFormPage + FormPreviewPage. Independent of FEAT-003; FEAT-002 depends on the Vitest setup and the editor Settings/save wiring landed here.
steps: PREREQUISITE (design §0): add `vitest` (^3.2.4, matching web) to apps/api devDependencies; replace the stub `"test"` script with `"test": "vitest run"` and add `"test:watch": "vitest"`; create apps/api/vitest.config.ts with `test: { environment: "node", include: ["src/**/*.test.ts"] }`. Run `pnpm install` in apps/api.

API type + defaults (§1.1): in apps/api/src/modules/forms/form.service.ts add a `FormTheme` type (coverImageUrl?/accentColor?/backgroundColor?/fontFamily? all optional) and `theme?: FormTheme` on the FormSchema.settings type; in getFormSchema copy `theme` through ONLY when present via conditional-spread (`...(candidate?.settings?.theme !== undefined ? { theme: candidate.settings.theme } : {})`) — never default to {}.

API Zod (§1.2, §1.11): in form.schemas.ts export FONT_ALLOW_LIST (Inter, Roboto, Poppins, Montserrat, Open Sans, Lora, Playfair Display, Source Sans 3) with a cross-ref comment naming apps/web/src/lib/theme.ts as the mirror (API enum authoritative); add a HEX_COLOR regex and `themeSchema = z.strictObject({ coverImageUrl: z.string().trim().url().max(2000).optional(), accentColor: HEX_COLOR.optional(), backgroundColor: HEX_COLOR.optional(), fontFamily: z.enum(FONT_ALLOW_LIST).optional() }).optional()`; add `theme: themeSchema` to updateFormSettingsSchema.

API merge (§1.3): in updateFormSettings add `...(input.theme !== undefined ? { theme: input.theme } : {})` (whole-object replace on present). getPublicForm needs NO change — theme rides through publicSettings automatically (confirm it is NOT added to the responseNotification/sendConfirmationEmail omit-list).

API unit test (§1.10): new apps/api/src/modules/forms/form.schemas.test.ts — updateFormSettingsSchema accepts a valid theme; rejects bad hex, non-allow-list font, non-URL cover, unknown keys (z.strictObject); FONT_ALLOW_LIST deep-equals the 8 expected names.

Web theme helper (§1.5, §1.6, §1.11): new apps/web/src/lib/theme.ts exporting DEFAULT_ACCENT='#2563eb'; FONT_ALLOW_LIST mirror (cross-ref comment); per-family Google-Fonts href + CSS-fallback-stack map; resolveTheme(theme, primaryColor?) returning { accent, background, fontFamily, coverImageUrl } where accent = theme?.accentColor ?? primaryColor ?? undefined (NEVER DEFAULT_ACCENT) and other fields are undefined when unset; ensureFontLoaded(family?) injecting a deduped <link data-qivo-font> and no-op on undefined.

Web theme test (§1.10, §1.11): new apps/web/src/lib/theme.test.ts — resolveTheme precedence (theme→primaryColor→undefined; preview mode omitting primaryColor → undefined accent when no theme accent); ensureFontLoaded injects once + no-ops on undefined; FONT_ALLOW_LIST drift guard deep-equals the 8 names.

Web types (§1.8): in apps/web/src/types/index.ts add FormTheme and `theme?: FormTheme`, plus `responseEditing?: "disabled"|"timed"|"until_close"` and `responseEditMinutes?: number` (used by FEAT-002) to FormSchema.settings.

Web upload helper (§1.7): new apps/web/src/lib/upload.ts `uploadToCloudinary(slug, file, onProgress?)` lifting the image-compress + signature + direct-Cloudinary XHR + image/raw resource-type flow out of PublicFormPage.uploadFileToCloudinary; refactor PublicFormPage to call it (behavior unchanged).

Editor Appearance tab (§1.7): in apps/web/src/pages/FormEditorPage.tsx extend EditorTab with 'appearance', add the tab button + panel, add state coverImageUrl/accentColor/backgroundColor/fontFamily loaded from schema.settings.theme on load; controls: Cloudinary cover upload gated on form.status==='PUBLISHED' (with the publish-to-upload / paste-URL note) + URL paste + Remove, accent color input + reset, background color input + reset, font select from FONT_ALLOW_LIST with a Default option, and a scaled live preview using resolveTheme + ensureFontLoaded; fold a `theme` object (set fields only; empty object clears) into saveFormSettings' PATCH body as body.theme.

PublicFormPage theme (§1.5): call resolveTheme(form.schema.settings.theme, form.branding?.primaryColor) + ensureFontLoaded; replace the three branding?.primaryColor inline reads (eyebrow ~L343, next ~L430, submit ~L439) with resolved.accent keeping conditional-spread (undefined emits no style); apply background/fontFamily to the .public-form-shell/-wrap container only when set; render a cover banner at the top of .public-form-wrap only when set.

FormPreviewPage theme (§1.5, §1.9): call resolveTheme(form.schema.settings.theme) (no primaryColor — FormRecord has none) + ensureFontLoaded; apply accent to eyebrow + submit/next buttons using resolved.accent ?? DEFAULT_ACCENT (custom buttons have no CSS default), background + font to the container, cover banner when set; add caption 'Workspace brand color is applied on the live form.'
acceptance_criteria: `cd apps/api && pnpm test` runs via Vitest and all new schema tests pass.
`cd apps/api && pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit` exits 0.
`cd apps/web && pnpm test` passes including theme.test.ts.

A form with no theme produces a public payload with no `theme` key and renders identically to before; the Appearance tab persists a theme via the settings PATCH and the public form reflects accent/background/font/cover.
verification: cd apps/api && pnpm install && pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm test
cd apps/web && pnpm exec tsc -b --noEmit && pnpm test
findings: DONE. Vitest added to apps/api (vitest@^3.2.4 devDep, scripts test=`vitest run`/test:watch=`vitest`, new apps/api/vitest.config.ts with node env + include src/**/*.test.ts). IMPORTANT: apps/api/tsconfig.json now has `"exclude": ["vitest.config.ts", "dist"]` — without it the config file violates rootDir:./src and tsc fails; FEAT-002 must NOT remove that exclude. New files: apps/api/src/modules/forms/form.schemas.test.ts, apps/web/src/lib/theme.ts, apps/web/src/lib/theme.test.ts. apps/web/src/lib/upload.ts gained `uploadToCloudinary(slug, file, onProgress?)` (lifted from PublicFormPage) plus an `import { publicPost } from "./api"`. apps/api form.schemas.ts exports FONT_ALLOW_LIST (8 names) + themeSchema (z.strictObject, HEX_COLOR regex) wired into updateFormSettingsSchema as `theme: themeSchema`. apps/api form.service.ts: added FormTheme type + `theme?: FormTheme` on FormSchema.settings; added `normalizeTheme(input.theme)` helper (rebuilds via conditional-spread because Zod infers `string|undefined` which fails exactOptionalPropertyTypes when assigned to FormTheme — reuse this pattern for any Zod-inferred optional-object merge); getFormSchema copies theme via conditional-spread; updateFormSettings merges `theme: normalizeTheme(input.theme)` when present; getPublicForm UNCHANGED (theme rides publicSettings, confirmed NOT in the responseNotification/sendConfirmationEmail omit-list). apps/web/src/types/index.ts: added `FormTheme` export and on FormSchema.settings added `theme?: FormTheme`, `responseEditing?: "disabled"|"timed"|"until_close"`, `responseEditMinutes?: number` (the latter two are for FEAT-002 — already present, do not re-add). theme.ts exports: DEFAULT_ACCENT='#2563eb', FONT_ALLOW_LIST (mirror), FontFamily type, ResolvedTheme type, resolveTheme(theme?, primaryColor?) (accent precedence theme->primaryColor->undefined, never DEFAULT_ACCENT; fontFamily resolves to a CSS fallback stack; unknown stored font -> undefined), ensureFontLoaded(family?) (deduped , no-op on undefined/unknown, guards typeof document). PublicFormPage: computes `resolved` + ensureFontLoaded before the final return, applies background/fontFamily to .public-form-shell, renders cover at top of .public-form-wrap, replaced the 3 branding.primaryColor inline reads with resolved.accent (conditional-spread preserved so un-themed forms stay byte-identical). FormPreviewPage: resolveTheme(theme only, no primaryColor) + previewAccent = resolved.accent ?? DEFAULT_ACCENT on eyebrow/next/submit, bg+font on container, cover banner, caption 'Workspace brand color is applied on the live form.'. FormEditorPage: EditorTab union gained 'appearance'; new state coverImageUrl/accentColor/backgroundColor/fontFamily/uploadingCover/coverError loaded from schema.settings.theme; Appearance tab button + panel with cover upload (gated on form.status==='PUBLISHED' with publish/paste note) + URL paste + Remove, accent/background color inputs with reset, font
